props.title: XLSX Export
props.description: Edit data in the table below, then click Download XLSX to export it as a spreadsheet — demonstrates renderGeneric with separate React and XLSX specs sharing one store.
props.technicalDescription:
Spec
React: CaseContainer → { BoundField(title), Table → [THead → Tr → Th×3, TBody(repeat:/rows) → Tr → [Td → BoundField×3]] }
XLSX: Workbook → Sheet → [XlsxRow(header), SheetData(repeat:/rows) → XlsxRow → XlsxCell($item:field)]
State
{ title, rows: [{ id, name, qty, price }] }
Features
• Two specs — React spec for interactive preview, XLSX spec for export, both using the same store
• renderGeneric — walks the XLSX spec tree, passes raw props + ctx to registry functions
• Expression resolution in registry — resolve() helper reads $state/$item from store via ctx
• ctx.basePath scoping — inside repeat, resolve() composes absolute paths from ctx.basePath
• xlsx builders — registry maps spec types to Workbook, Sheet, XlsxRow, XlsxCell
• XLSX.write + Blob download — one-click .xlsx generation
